profileName: Samsung QE50Q60B (2022, Tizen 6.5) via Plex for Samsung - zero video transcode
notes: Edit this file to tune what Invoke-MediaIngest.ps1 accepts, fixes, or quarantines.
Codec names are ffprobe codec_name values. Profiles are ffprobe 'profile' strings.
Video is NEVER re-encoded. Anything whose video is not playable is quarantined.

rejectReasons.mpeg4: MPEG-4 Part 2 (XviD/DivX) is not reliably direct-played by Plex on Tizen
rejectReasons.msmpeg4v3: MS-MPEG4 v3 is not supported on Tizen
rejectReasons.vc1: VC-1 would require a server video transcode
rejectReasons.wmv3: WMV3 would require a server video transcode
rejectReasons.mpeg2video: MPEG-2 would require a server video transcode
rejectReasons.mpeg1video: MPEG-1 would require a server video transcode

dolbyVision.note: Samsung TVs have no Dolby Vision. Profiles 7 and 8.x play their HDR10/SDR base layer; profile 5 has none (wrong colours or forced tone-map transcode).

subtitles.note: Image subtitles (PGS/VobSub) force Plex to burn them in = video transcode. They are removed; use .srt sidecars instead.

bitrate.note: Samsung TV LAN ports are commonly 10/100. Above ~60 Mbps average, use strong 5 GHz Wi-Fi on the TV or expect buffering on peaks.
